correctness_scope: Full payload before AND after timed repeats at every rank/size. Vendor collective check enabled; inspect each status.
selection: Median pair throughput at 256 MiB under concurrent pairs; maximum of local/cross small-payload medians for effective runtime P2P latency.
timing_scope: ACL events after a host-callback gate; prequeue all HCCL calls and release after an MPI barrier. Device timing excludes enqueue gaps; wall timing includes queue preparation. Half round trip includes HCCL protocol, not bare-wire propagation.
scope: Two Atlas 800T A3 nodes in SuperPod 1; 16 Ascend910_9382 runtime chips each; mixed host drivers.
